name: Actors
overview: Scripture warns believers to be discerning of those who outwardly appear harmless or righteous but inwardly harbor harmful intentions, as seen in the caution against false prophets in Matthew 7:15. Our existence and purpose are rooted in God, who is the source of life and being, as affirmed in Acts 17:28. Furthermore, James 1:22 exhorts Christians to actively live out God's Word rather than merely listening to it, avoiding self-deception. Together, these verses emphasize the importance of genuine faith expressed through true actions rather than mere appearances or empty words.
